claims.evidence: Location (Ibadan) is not shown in the photo; 'scrap' status is not provable from the image alone.
Photo does not show battery date/label, internal inspection, or any proof of new cells.

risks.risk: Capacity (mAh/Wh) is unknown; '8 hours' depends heavily on the phone/load and actual battery health/capacity.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label/specs (mAh/Wh, output ratings) plus a runtime test video showing the power bank charging a phone at a stated brightness/load for a timed duration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as low-capacity/unknown performance (worst case: not reliable for long runtime).

risks.risk: Possible rework/repair or unsafe battery condition (tape/patching visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seams/ports and any internal opening (if safe) OR a video showing the unit being opened and the battery brand/date printed on the cells.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially repaired/unstable (worst case: reduced lifespan or intermittent charging).

risks.risk: Charging/output may be faulty (ports/cables, voltage regulation).
risks.proof: Video of charging a phone from 0% to 100% and a multimeter reading of output voltage/current (or a phone charging indicator that stays consistent).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to charge reliably (worst case: works intermittently or not at full output).

risks.risk: Safety risk: damaged casing or battery swelling/heat during use.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the power bank under load (charging) with no overheating/smell and checking for swelling (press test) before and after 10–15 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unsafe/unknown safety (worst case: avoidable risk—discount heavily).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of any label/specs (mAh/Wh, brand, model, output: 5V/2A etc.).
Video test: charge a phone from a stated starting % to a stated ending % with a timer (and show the phone charging indicator).
Multimeter reading of output voltage/current while charging (or a charger tester reading).
Close-up of the taped/patch area and ports; ideally a safe internal photo showing battery cell markings.
response.reason: The photo shows used/taped cylindrical power banks with no readable capacity/brand and no verifiable test results. Without proof of capacity and charging performance, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
